rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone is thrilled, especially when the excitement is obvious.

example.english: I'm absolutely thrilled that I can go see my idol's concert tomorrow!
example.traditional: 聽日可以去睇偶像演唱會，我真係好興奮呀！
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 tai2 ngau5 zoeng6 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hing1 fan5 aa1

rows.note: Choose this when “thrilled” means delighted or very happy about good news rather than visibly excited.

example.english: I'm thrilled to hear that you got the job.
example.traditional: 聽到你攞到份工，我真係好開心呀。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 nei5 lo2 dou3 fan6 gung1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3
